name: Habib Nasrullah
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Denver, Colorado
about: Habib Nasrullah is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2006, 2010 - 2027. He works at Wheeler Trigg O'Donnell LLP, located in Denver, Colorado, and provides legal services for issues involving Business Litigation and Class Action / Mass Torts: Defense to the surrounding community.
Habib Nasrullah completed legal studies at Georgetown University Law Center and graduated with the class of 1988. Habib Nasrullah passed the bar in 1988.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
